title: Create sales returns from authorized outbound source selection and remaining capacity
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add bounded authenticated sales-return source candidate/detail APIs and business form selector using current enabled sales-return and stock-out permissions and existing customer scope before counts/data. Filter exact approved nondeleted outbound document by customer/warehouse, allow bounded keyword search; project exact source id/no and product/spec/base unit with net available return quantity from effective approved returns, aggregating duplicate products without multiplying source quantities. Zero capacity or corrupt/unit-unknown source is unavailable; exclude foreign/deleted/cancelled sources. No arbitrary queries, new grants or schema.

Explicit selection fills authoritative source id/no/customer/warehouse and available source product lines, lets operator enter positive partial quantity and retains actual unit/cost semantics without inventing price or financial posting. Save/reopen preserves exact source; explicit unlinked historical returns remain compatible. Actual controller repeats all eligibility and cumulative capacity checks under existing source locks at create/submit/approve, so stale candidates or concurrent return cannot over-return. Denied or stale edits leave original document/stock/ledger unchanged and retain form input. Real SQL permissions, duplicate products/partial returns/stale cancellation/race cases and executable JS selection/save/reopen tests plus real browser or documented blocker.
